import html # The HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Message
{user_content}
""" def build_html_output(client_message: str) -> str: """ Safely embed a user-provided message into an HTML template. Parameters ---------- client_message : str The raw content supplied by the user that will be inserted into the template. Returns ------- str A complete HTML document with the user content escaped to prevent XSS attacks. """ # Escape special HTML characters to avoid injection vulnerabilities escaped_content = html.escape(client_message, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=escaped_content)
